meta.name: Midad
meta.description: Single source of truth for the Institutional Theme. Edit here, then run `node scripts/build-tokens.mjs`. Never edit generated files by hand.
meta.value_syntax: A value is one of: `ramp.step` (primitive reference), `@name` (semantic reference), `#rrggbb`, `oklch(L C H)`, `alpha(<value>, <0..1>)`, or any other string, which is emitted verbatim.

brand._comment: WHITE-LABEL ENTRY POINT. To adopt official colours set `primary_hex` and/or `accent_hex`: the ramp keeps its lightness curve and takes hue and chroma from the supplied colour. Leave null to keep the neutral Midad identity. Re-run the build; the contrast audit must still pass.

palettes._comment: Selectable colour presets. `midad` is the default for Light and Dark and is exactly the approved design. Every other preset re-uses the ink and brass lightness curves with a different hue and a chroma multiplier, so text contrast is preserved by construction; each must still pass the full contrast and colour-blind audits in both modes before it ships. Hex values are indicative (computed with design/reference/color.mjs); the build pipeline is authoritative.

forest.risk: Primary sits near the success hue. Must pass a status-distinguishability check (primary button vs success pill) or be dropped.

umber.risk: Primary sits near the pending hue. Same distinguishability check as forest.

ink.role: Primary. Prussian ink: the colour of the institution's signature.

brass.role: Accent. Antique brass: the seal on the document. Under 5% of any screen.

slate.role: Light-mode neutrals with a cool ink undertone (hue 255).

night.role: Dark-mode neutrals, hand-tuned. 950-700 are layered surfaces (higher = lighter), 600-450 are borders, 400-50 are text.

red.role: Danger, rejected, cancelled, overdue. Oxide red.

blue.role: Submitted, in progress, links. Azure, same family as ink.

surface-sunken.use: Sidebar, filter bar, wells, table header tonal step.

surface-hover.use: Hover on rows, menu items, quiet buttons.

_approved._deviation: ADR 0010: lightness 0.35 to 0.34 so help text passes 4.5 on a selected and hovered row.

surface-fill.use: Neutral fill for secondary buttons and chips.

surface-scrim.use: Backdrop behind dialogs and the freeze overlay.

border-control.use: Input, checkbox and switch boundary (3:1 or better).

primary.use: Primary button, checked controls, active tab rule.

accent.use: Signature rule, active marker. Never text.

focus.use: Focus ring, 2px, on every interactive element.

status._comment: One status language. Each role carries a background, a foreground, a border and a solid (dot, chart, icon).

status-pending-bg.use: Pending approval, not saved, to do.

chart._comment: Categorical order is fixed. Series also differ in lightness so they survive grayscale; pair with direct labels and dash or marker patterns.

_approved._deviation: ADR 0010: series reordered 1,5,3,2,6,4 so every neighbouring pair stays distinguishable in all visions.
ADR 0010: series reordered 1,5,3,2,6,4 so every neighbouring pair stays distinguishable in all visions.
ADR 0010: series reordered 1,5,3,2,6,4 so every neighbouring pair stays distinguishable in all visions.
ADR 0010: series reordered 1,5,3,2,6,4 so every neighbouring pair stays distinguishable in all visions.

elevation._comment: Three steps: flat (none), raised, overlay, plus dialog. Light uses hairline and shadow; dark uses a lighter surface and a hairline ring.

scroll-shadow-start.use: Edge cue: more content towards inline-start (physical left).

scroll-shadow-end.use: Edge cue: more content towards inline-end (physical right).

scale._comment: Mode-independent tokens. `compact` values apply under [data-ins-density=compact]; `coarse` under (pointer: coarse).

font-sans.value: "IBM Plex Sans", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", "Noto Sans Arabic", Tahoma, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
font-sans.use: UI text. Latin and Arabic faces are split by unicode-range, so one stack serves both scripts.

font-mono.value: "IBM Plex Mono", "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, "DejaVu Sans Mono", "Courier New", monospace
font-mono.use: Codes, IDs, references. Dotted zero; distinct I, l, 1.

text-xs.use: Smallest readable size: captions, pills, timestamps.

leading-arabic.use: Arabic body text: +0.15 for taller ascenders and descenders.

weight-strong.use: Heaviest weight shipped. No synthetic bold.

radius-sm.use: Control tier: inputs, buttons, pills, tags.

radius-md.use: Container tier: cards, widgets, menus, popovers.

control-height-sm.use: Small buttons in toolbars and table footers.

control-pad-x.use: Inline padding of inputs and buttons.

z-banner.use: Connection and session banners, below Bootstrap dropdowns (1000 is menus; 1040+ is modals).

frappe._comment: Layer 2: Frappe's own variables, re-pointed at Layer 1/semantic tokens. `both` applies to light and dark alike. Every name here is read or declared by the core CSS of a supported Frappe version, or used by this theme (python -m institutional_theme.audits, ADR 0011 R5). A name that only one version reads is still emitted: it does nothing in the other.

--disabled-text-color.note: Core uses this only for read-only values (.like-disabled-input), which must stay legible.

--text-muted.note: Core 'muted' is its secondary text level (76 uses).

--primary.note: Declared only by Bootstrap's :root (after Frappe's dark block) and has no dark value in core.

--frappe-card-button-color.note: Core points this at --ink-blue-6, which is never defined.

--charts-stroke-width.note: Core dark sets 5px; one stroke weight keeps both modes the same chart.

--elevation-sm.note: v16.52.0 only (N26, R2a: --shadow-sm is its alias)

--elevation-lg.note: v16.52.0 only (N29, R2a; the toast reads it (token map D3))

--focus-default.note: Focus is drawn with outline (survives forced-colors). Core also applies this on .btn:active.

--text-tiny.note: Core is 11px; nothing readable goes below 12px.

--weight-regular.note: Core is 420 for variable Inter; with static faces 420 would resolve to 500.

--font-weight-regular.note: v16.52.0 only (N17, R2a: --weight-regular is its alias)

contrast._comment: Every pair is measured in both modes by scripts/audit-contrast.mjs. `min` fails the build; `target` only warns. fg/bg are semantic names, or Frappe variables.

groups.name: Help text on hover and selected rows
Status glyph and dot against the pill and the page
Status solids against surfaces (dots, trend arrows, chart marks)
Primary button boundary against the page
Destructive button boundary against the page
Error border against the page and field
Chart marks against the plot background

max.name: Chart gridlines stay quiet (at most 10% contrast step)
